title: kbmon's sessions panel lists each overlap between live sessions with its announced strategy, and an undecided overlap enters the needs-you line
goal: the sessions panel's data and view gain overlaps: each pair of live sessions whose intents' items or touches meet, with both labels and operator ids, the items, the shared files and the strategy a coordinate event announced or undecided; an overlap still undecided after announce.needs_you_after_min minutes (kbsettings, read for the clone at --root) is an entry of the needs-you line naming the two items, so it also reaches --status all, the receipt and the mod

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, sys, json, uuid
T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', T])
json.dump({'coordination': {'announce': {'needs_you_after_min': 0}}}, open(os.path.join(T, 'settings.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'))
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
for item in ('ST-ab12cd34', 'ST-ef56gh78'):
    sid = str(uuid.uuid4())
    c('claim', 'session/' + sid, '--ttl', '600', '--holder', sid)
    c('post', '--kind', 'intent', '--field', 'session=' + sid, '--field', 'item=' + item, '--field', 'touch=_tools/bl_land.py')
k = lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kbmon.py', *a, '--root', T, '--store', S], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
snap, status = k('--json', '--panel', 'sessions'), k('--status', 'all', '--json')
try:
    ov = json.loads(snap.stdout)['panels']['sessions']['data'].get('overlaps', [])
    first = json.loads(status.stdout)['lines'][0]
except (ValueError, KeyError, IndexError):
    ov, first = [], ''
ok = len(ov) == 1 and 'overlap' in first and 'ST-ab12cd34' in first
print('overlaps', ov, '| needs line:', first[:160])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
